Daily Agenda
Parliament,

Letter from the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers
1. The Honorable Speaker will read out the letter received from the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers regarding the additional work.
Management Work
Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sovita Gautam:
2. a) To present a proposal seeking permission to present the "Nepal Law Commission (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
 b) To present the "Nepal Law Commission (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sovita Gautam, will present a proposal to "Consider the Mediation (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083".
3. Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sovita Gautam, will present a proposal to "Consider the Mediation (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083".
Treaty Related Work
Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sovita Gautam, will present the "Proposal regarding the accession to the membership of the Council of Asian Legislative Institutions (CALI)" to the House.
Panchan Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
